assertions.assertion: Identifies that the storage provider is selected with AddStorage(...) on the IdentityServer builder, not inside the AddUserManagement lambda
assertions.rationale: Says AddSqliteStore is wrong inside the lambda but then chains invented .AddSqliteStore after AddUserManagement; no AddStorage.

assertions.assertion: Shows the correct pattern: .AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(options => options.ConnectionString = ...)).AddUserManagement(...)
Mentions the schema must be created/migrated with IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync()
Does NOT suggest using EF Core migrations as a fix
assertions.rationale: Suggests `EnsureCreated`/migration at startup, an EF Core-style fix.
